Settings

Groq API Key

Stored locally in this browser only, never sent anywhere but api.groq.com. Get a free key at console.groq.com/keys.
Smart Suggestions, the Asset Scanner, and search assist use qwen/qwen3.6-27b. Ask Groq uses groq/compound-mini for live web search on troubleshooting and manuals.

Help

Home — your property overview, hero photos, and the 3D model viewer. Tap the photo's + / trash icons to manage the gallery.
Assets — every tracked item in the house. Switch "Space" (Interior/Exterior → room) or "Type" (HVAC, Plumbing, etc.) to browse differently. Tap an asset for service history, photos, and Ask Groq troubleshooting.
Finishes — paint, tile, and material reference pulled from the builder's selection sheet. Tap the pencil icon to edit or add entries.
Documents — upload plans, permits, warranties, and insurance paperwork. Stored on this device only.
Smart Suggestions (sparkle icon, Assets view) — Groq checks your inventory for common gaps, like a washer with no dryer.
Ask Groq to search — appears whenever a search comes up empty; Groq re-checks your data for a looser match.

About

HomeLog is a local-first home maintenance and reference app. Everything — assets, photos, finishes, documents — is stored in this browser's IndexedDB, never uploaded anywhere. Groq API calls (Smart Suggestions, Ask Groq, search assist) send only the minimal text needed for that request.
Built for the Lazzaro Residence · St. Cloud, FL · LAZLAB Creations
